notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for mixed ordinary attribute ownership queries. The source uses only the official IEEE RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, two-attribute FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies exact owned and unowned attribute partitions, invalid object and attribute failures, and suppression of ownership-query results that have not crossed the callback boundary when the object is removed. It does not assert provider-specific names, registries, headers, callback ordering, or implementation behavior.
